authentication: Replace ${TOKEN} with the raw value of the TOKEN environment variable. Both routes are relative to COORDINATOR_ENDPOINT, including its path prefix.

request.count: Positive integer equal to free worker slots plus DEMO_SURPLUS minus URLs already waiting. Haste sends at most one refill request at a time.

expected_response.body: A JSON array of replay URL strings. The coordinator can return fewer than count. Each URL must use HTTP or HTTPS and an allowed replay host.
expected_response.client_behavior: Haste queues every URL in a partial batch and requests the remaining shortfall. An empty array or an empty 2xx response body delays the next poll by 30 seconds. A failed request or malformed response delays it by 2 seconds.

request.body: A nonempty JSON array with one complete parser result per match. Even a single result is wrapped in an array. The example abbreviates the match metadata.

expected_response.body: Optional. Haste ignores the response body.
expected_response.client_behavior: After a network failure or non-2xx response, Haste keeps the batch in memory and includes newly completed matches in the retry. Retries start after 2 seconds and double up to 60 seconds. If an acknowledgement is lost, the coordinator may receive a match again.
